The software product **IcoMoon** at **icomoon.io** is operated and provided by **Roonas** (legally incorporated as **Roonas** / **Roonas Corporation**, based in North Hollywood, California), and created/maintained by developer **Keyamoon** (Mahdi Rahmani Mofrad).

### Supporting Evidence & Provider Statements
* **Operating Entity Disclosures:** Official privacy notices and software license disclosures identifying the service provider for `icomoon.io` state:
  * *"icomoon.io is created and maintained by Keyamoon. Provider is the Roonas corp."* (*"icomoon.io wird von Keyamoon erstellt und gewartet. Anbieter ist die Roonas corp."*)
  * *"IcoMoon Icons (CDN). Wir binden Schriftarten und Icons (Symbole) ('IcoMoon Fonts') des Anbieters Roonas Corporation (11490 BURBANK BLVD STE 6A, NORTH HOLLYWOOD CA 91601, United States) ein... Servern von Roonas (icomoon.io)"*
  * *"IcoMoon (operado por Roonas, 11490 Burbank Blvd Ste 6A, North Hollywood, 91601 California, EE. UU.)"*
* **Software Copyright / Attribution:** Software licenses and open-source credits for `icomoon.io` credit the product to *"IcoMoon Limited (C) Roonas"* and *"IcoMoon. https://icomoon.io/ ... Copyright Roonas"*.
* **Developer:** The project and repository releases are maintained under the developer handle **Keyamoon**.

record.description: IcoMoon is a web-based platform that specializes in offering a vast array of vector icons and tools for creating custom icon fonts and SVG sprites. Users can choose from thousands of high-quality icons or upload their own vector graphics to enhance their design projects. The service includes a free HTML5 application for easy customization and integration of icons.
